scope: Owner-requested comparative playthrough audit of all 15 live Opera job games against well-rated published games, delivered as a written handoff. Free reference games were installed and played in a cloud workspace (21 activities, 10 scripted runs each where valid); each career was played 10 times through an audit harness on the real touch and emulated-mouse paths. It benefits the child by naming, with measurements, where published games are objectively better (agency, variety, per-touch sound, kept creations) and by surfacing blocking defects with reproductions (Boxer emulated-mouse glove claim, Ballerina and Magician 0.999 trace locks, Astronaut pipe-hint soft-lock, Detective retry reset, frame-rate trace rejection, one-tap Back exit). No game script, scene, asset, audio or workflow is changed; no image is committed.
no_findings_reason: Analysis-only handoff: no finding is repaired or changed. The defects it reports carry reproduction lines for owner/Codex triage into the finding register; MA-OPERA-014 (Pop Star, Ballerina, Racer rebuild) is cited, not changed.

validation.evidence: Run on a docs-only sparse checkout; see commit message and CI for the full-tree result.

validation.command: Independent claim verification by a separate agent against run logs, reference logs and code anchors
validation.evidence: 76 confirmed, 21 wrong and 7 unsupported items found on the first draft; every wrong or unsupported item was corrected or removed before commit.

acceptance_gaps: Nothing is implemented. All runs are scripted policies, not a child; references were played by mouse/keyboard on a loaded software-rendered VM; no sound was heard; commercial references are documented only until the PC round. Every defect needs confirmation on the Lenovo tablet, and every redesign item needs runtime, device, child and owner gates.
